# Sequence-learning completeness assessment

## Current runtime

### CUR-001
The observer is a post-close evaluator, not a universal action monitor. It reconstructs only one safe operation context with contiguous checked-exec claim/return pairs, a passed run, and final same-path verification, then returns NO_CANDIDATE, LINK_REGISTERED, LINK_DISCOVERY, or PROPOSE_DISCOVERY. Other action classes lack canonical producers.

### CUR-002
Recognition is advisory before governed-path entry. Selection and guard fail closed only after the model invokes them. The deployed Codex skill is older than the repository contract, and no accessible Codex-host source proves arbitrary pre-dispatch interception.

### CUR-003
An eligible complete checked-exec success can bootstrap discovery automatically at run close. Qualification, promotion, registered verification, and reuse qualification remain explicitly controller-driven.

### CUR-004
Blockers and corrections bind run, lineage, subject, step, changed artifacts, bundle transition, and same-path successor proof. No current contract joins a model self-diagnosis to the exact action/failure or derives a canonical repair candidate.

### CUR-005
Lifecycle outcomes are durable, but registered correction is an in-place bundle transition. There is no immutable version identity, quarantined old version, requalification candidate, or atomic selector cutover.

### CUR-006
Silver and gold are not canonical states. Existing run/correction metrics do not measure eligible observations, lifecycle conversion, registered reuse, false matches, evidence holds, or wrong-step recurrence with stable denominators.

### CUR-007
Only guarded direct argv through checked exec has authoritative per-action records. File edits, browser, generic MCP/tool, subagent, and reasoning actions have no work-memory producers. Remote workflow execution persists aggregate invocation/output but not canonical internal action events.

## Future system

### FUT-001
Use a closed safe action-event contract with producer, stable identity, normalized non-secret intent, outcome link, observer consumer, and visible unsupported status for every in-scope dispatch surface.

### FUT-002
Decide exact registered applicability before effect dispatch; route proven matches through activation, guard, and existing approvals, while ambiguity/staleness/unsupported actions fail visibly.

### FUT-003
Build one canonical candidate only from a completed ordered successful trace with grounded inputs, dependencies, failure handling, verification, and provenance; incomplete evidence becomes a typed hold.

### FUT-004
Treat model self-diagnosis as a signal. Causal authority requires an action ID, failure/fingerprint, blocker occurrence, claimed step, replacement evidence, and same-path successor verification.

### FUT-005
After proof, the corrected canonical path includes the replacement and excludes the wrong step; later compatible dispatch must receive the corrected path or a fail-closed hold.

### FUT-006
Repair registered sequences by immutable replacement version: quarantine old, carry provenance, requalify and register-verify new, then atomically cut over selector eligibility.

### FUT-007
Silver is a complete deduplicated proven discovery that is not registered-selectable. Gold is a current registered version with governed qualification and registered same-path verification. All entry/promotion/demotion/supersession/expiration transitions are machine-readable.

### FUT-008
Measure eligible opportunities, matches, holds, silver creation, duplicates, conversion, gold reuse, corrected reuse, false matches, correction latency, and known-wrong-step recurrence using immutable provenance and denominators.

### FUT-009
Extend canonical fingerprinting, bounded suppression, evidence hashes, and reconciliation conflict checks so identical evidence yields one lineage and stale/partial/low-value evidence creates no churn.

### FUT-010
Assign one canonical cross-runtime owner and explicit idempotent resume, event union, branch conflict, and current-version synchronization rules.

### FUT-011
Use closed schemas and redact before persistence; reject credentials, auth payloads, transcripts, hidden reasoning, personal data, and raw outputs while retaining safe provenance.

### FUT-012
Keep observation, matching, execution approval, correction approval, qualification, promotion, registration, and directive authority separate and fail closed.

### FUT-013
Bind governed feedback to candidate/version identity and consume it only through immutable declared rule versions; no silent self-tuning.

### FUT-014
Require two real-boundary proofs: unrecorded success becomes silver then gold and is reused before dispatch; a wrong step is causally corrected into a replacement version and cannot recur on the next compatible task.

MG-001 action-producer coverage; MG-002 pre-dispatch interception; MG-003 closed success-learning loop; MG-004 causal self-diagnosis-to-repair join; MG-005 immutable registered repair; MG-006 silver/gold and effectiveness contracts; MG-007 cross-runtime/branch-safe state ownership.
